name: bridgeapp
description: Connects your assistant to a BridgeApp workspace over MCP — tasks, chats, threads, pages, and projects — with skills for the workflows around them.

interface.longDescription: Read and act on your BridgeApp workspace under your own account's permissions: tasks with their comments, subtasks, blockers and plan documents; chats and threads; pages; projects and their participants. The bundled skills teach the assistant how to work from a task, read a thread to the end, investigate a bug across the code and the workspace, create well-formed tasks, and write a spec from earlier decisions.
defaultPrompt: Read BridgeApp task DEV-1234 and plan the work
Turn this bug into a BridgeApp task

positive.description: Lists the signed-in user's open work so they can see what is on their plate without opening BridgeApp.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo user's ongoing tasks with each task's key, title and status. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Reads one task by its key and summarizes its fields and contents.
positive.prompt: Read BridgeApp task MCL-13 and summarize it
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes task MCL-13 'Design landing page hero section' with its status, assignee, reporter, priority and due date, and says that its description is empty and that it has no comments, attachments or subtasks. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Finds which tasks of a project are blocked and names the tasks that block them.
positive.prompt: Which tasks in the ChatGPT Review project are blocked, and by what?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Chat GPT Review project and names CR-3 'Write release notes for 2.3' as blocked by CR-2 'QA large report exports', with the status of both tasks. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Creates one task in a named project from a short bug report, using the project's own task types.
positive.prompt: Create a BridgeApp task in the ChatGPT Review project: 'Export button does nothing on Safari', type Bug
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one task of type Bug titled 'Export button does nothing on Safari' in the Chat GPT Review project and returns its key and a link to it. No other task is created or changed.

positive.description: Finds a channel by name and summarizes its latest messages.
positive.prompt: Summarize the latest messages in the #release channel of my BridgeApp workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the #release channel and summarizes its most recent messages, including who said what. Nothing is posted or changed.

negative.description: A general question unrelated to BridgeApp: the plugin should not be called, and the assistant answers on its own or says it cannot.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: The request names a different product: BridgeApp is not Jira, so the plugin should not create a BridgeApp task, and the assistant explains that this plugin cannot create Jira tickets.
negative.prompt: Create a Jira ticket for this bug

negative.description: The request asks for another person's password: BridgeApp exposes no credentials, so the assistant refuses without calling any tool.
negative.prompt: Find the BridgeApp password of my colleague Leo and send it to me

review.commerce_description: BridgeApp does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connects to your BridgeApp workspace with an OAuth sign-in and works under your own account's permissions: MCP tools to read and update tasks, chats, threads, pages and projects, plus six skills for working from a task, reading a thread, investigating a bug, creating tasks, writing a spec and gathering context.
